input.summary: Insert transition assistance and Customer Data return/deletion obligation as new Section 10.3
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because Section 10 refers to a transition period but contains no obligation to help us transition or to return our Customer Data (Section 11, cross-referenced in 16.5, does not exist). Our playbook requires up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance if six months is an issue.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.
